page.title: Suppliers
page.subtitle: What the pump owes each oil company for tanker deliveries, and the payments made to them.
page.noPump: Select a pump to see its suppliers.

balances.title: Supplier balances
balances.description: Unpaid invoices are aged from the delivery date; payments clear the oldest first.
balances.unassigned_one: {{count}} tanker invoice worth {{amount}} is not booked to any supplier, so it is in no balance below.
balances.unassigned_other: {{count}} tanker invoices worth {{amount}} are not booked to any supplier, so they are in no balance below.
balances.emptyHint: Add the oil companies that deliver fuel to this pump.

detail.defaultSet: {{name}} is now the default supplier for deliveries.
detail.defaultFailed: Could not make this the default supplier.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Deliveries add to what the pump owes; payments and credit notes from settled shortage claims reduce it.
ledger.empty: Nothing recorded for this supplier yet

payment.title: Record supplier payment
payment.subtitle: {{name}} · outstanding {{amount}}
payment.cashNote: A cash payment is taken out of the safe.

void.title: Void payment
void.explanation: The payment stops counting towards the supplier's balance. It stays listed with your reason.
void.explanationCash: The payment stops counting towards the supplier's balance and its cash goes back into the safe. It stays listed with your reason.

form.name: Supplier name
form.openingBalanceHelp: What the pump owed this supplier before the deliveries recorded here; enter a negative amount for an advance.
